subject: [PATCH v6 03/12] mm, swap: prepare the swap IO path for vswap

2026-10-21.patch_summary: This patch prepares the swap IO path for vswap by allowing it to submit IO for a swap entry other than folio->swap. It introduces a new sector calculation function, swap_entry_sector, and updates various functions to use this new function instead of swap_folio_sector. The patch also adds a 'nofs' flag to the swap_io_ctx structure to carry reclaim's NOFS restriction in the I/O context. This change is necessary for adding a physical swap backend for vswap. There are no functional changes as all callers currently pass folio->swap.
